reference.text: Кто-то гуляет, кто-то выносит книгу на скамейку. Можно просто начать здороваться — дальше разговоры находятся сами.
reference.voiceDescription: A man in his early thirties, native Russian with clear standard Russian pronunciation and no foreign accent. A clear, slightly bright middle male register with firm but easy articulation. Casual, open and grounded, sharing an everyday observation with a neighbor. Friendly interest and a modest smile, gently varying emphasis across the sentence. Natural conversational pauses, neither romantic nor promotional.
